data.body: Duplicate of a83f-6348-a08c-401d (georgiaite-flawless-sawfish), whose fix MERGED as Gerrit change 2142 = 1a2b59ea912d ('plan-review: scope sign fence to the subject') before this ticket was filed's observations could recur: the store-wide before/after HEAD fence and locked_head disjunct this ticket describes were DELETED; the sole pre-sign check is now the under-lock re-collect vs the immutable initial generation, and transient store-read-failure under the lock takes a bounded jittered retry. Live post-fix verification on the busy store: 5a30-d423's attestation signed after 19+ pre-fix failures; 2392-9389 signed on attempt 4 immediately after the fix landed; bb3a-c931 and 111a/7931 recovered via sign-review. The liveness property this ticket asks for (signing succeeds under sustained peer churn) is exactly what the merged fix provides. Closing as duplicate; if starvation recurs on a post-1a2b59ea91 build, reopen with fresh occurrence data.
